name: Extract a public webpage as Markdown with FetchRelay

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ url: $json.url, formats: ["markdown"], mode: "auto", onlyMainContent: true, timeout: 25000 }) }}

parameters.content:
## Try FetchRelay on a public webpage
1. Get a key at https://fetchrelay.com/integrations/n8n?utm_source=n8n&utm_medium=integration&utm_campaign=n8n-launch
2. Configure Header Auth on Extract with FetchRelay: Authorization = Bearer YOUR_FETCHRELAY_API_KEY.
3. Edit Website URL and execute manually. Inspect the validated Markdown output.
One successful page uses one credit. Errors and warnings stop the workflow; no automatic retries. Store keys in credentials only. Website content is untrusted.
